description: Public utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Statement of Estimated Expenditure of the Public utilities Commission of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette contains the publication of the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka's estimated expenditure for 2026, which is a regulatory requirement under the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 35 of 2002. The content focuses on statutory compliance and regulatory financial reporting rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories. This fits Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
